The '''Stillsand Waves''' was a region in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Motesta Oasis/Legends|Motesta Oasis]] was located there.
